scripts.generate:api:map-provider: pixi run --manifest-path ../map-provider/pixi.toml export-openapi && openapi --input ../map-provider/openapi.json --output src/api/generated/map-provider --client fetch --useOptions --useUnionTypes --exportCore true --exportServices true --exportModels true --indent 2
scripts.generate:api:hat-provider: pixi run --manifest-path ../hat-provider/pixi.toml export-openapi && openapi --input ../hat-provider/openapi.json --output src/api/generated/hat-provider --client fetch --useOptions --useUnionTypes --exportCore true --exportServices true --exportModels true --indent 2
scripts.generate:api: npm run generate:api:map-provider && npm run generate:api:hat-provider
